name: Austronesian peoples
summary: Seafaring peoples whose languages spread from Taiwan through the Philippines, Indonesia, the Pacific and as far as Madagascar, carried by outrigger canoes. (The source maps also use this name for the islands before the Austronesian expansion.)

knownFor.label: Outrigger canoe
knownFor.note: Canoes with side floats, stable enough for ocean voyages.

knownFor.label: Lapita pottery
knownFor.note: Decorated pottery of the first settlers of Remote Oceania.

knownFor.label: Star navigation
knownFor.note: Finding the way by stars, waves and birds.
